Arcanist.description:
Self-hosted, open source music server: a personal or family streaming service for your own music shares, with a web player, Subsonic and mStream compatible apps, DLNA and an admin panel with a setup wizard. Ultimate Cloud account optional.

Based on the official OCI image, available for amd64 and arm64 architecture. Rockstor V5.5.0 or later.
Arcanist.more_info:
First run

Open the WebUI and follow the setup wizard. The browser is not on the same machine as the container, so the wizard asks for a setup code: it is in docker logs arcanist (from a Rockstor shell) and in the file setup-code.txt of the Data share. The administration panel is at /admin.

Permissions

The container runs as the owner and group of the Data share (set them in the share's Access control tab). Give that user read access to the Music share, or write access to upload, organize or import music, and the same to any music share added later with Add Storage. Inside Arcanist the music is under /music.

Updating

Uninstall and install the Rock-on again with the same shares: the newest image is pulled and the data is kept.

8484.description: Arcanist's web player, admin panel and API.
8484.label: WebUI port [e.g. 8484]

/data.description: Share for Arcanist's database, settings, keys, caches and logs. The container runs as the owner and group of this share, e.g. (1000:100).
/data.label: Data Storage [e.g. arcanist-data]

/music.description: Share with your music. The owner of the Data share must be able to read it (and write to it to upload, organize or import). More music shares can be added after install.
/music.label: Music Storage [e.g. music]
